prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / illustration-story. Create ONE finished final end-card thumbnail for a Japanese manga review video, titled exactly 「男子校のくらげ先生」. Landscape 16:9, target 1920x1080, opaque. This is a new polished coherent illustration combining the established characters and sunny school-infirmary background, not a grid of panels or a character sheet.
Reference image 1 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY and SERIES STYLE reference for Mizumaki Kurage: adult 24-year-old female school nurse, chin-length dark blue-black straight bob with blunt bangs and purple-pink underside/tips, turquoise-green eyes, white open lab coat over a fully buttoned charcoal-gray cardigan, denim shorts. Preserve this exact face, hair, eye colors and clothing.
Reference image 2 is the CHARACTER IDENTITY reference for Kenji Zushi: youthful teenage schoolboy, short upright spiky black hair, expressive thick angular brows, brown eyes, white short-sleeved open-collar uniform shirt, dark navy trousers, navy schoolbag. Keep him fully clothed in ordinary school-comedy presentation.
Reference image 3 is the USER-SUPPLIED identity/color reference for narrator Tohoku Kiritan. One Kiritan only, chibi proportions, dark burgundy bob and ahoge, red eyes, gray-and-white knife-shaped side ornaments, pale cream pink kimono top with black trim, lime green sash, burgundy obi/back bow, dark purple pleated skirt. DO NOT recolor her hair or outfit blue. Give her an expressive active presenting pose: smiling, leaning slightly forward and pointing diagonally up toward the title with one hand, the other holding a manga. She must not be stiffly standing with both arms at her sides.
Reference image 4 is a LOGO DESIGN / TYPE HIERARCHY reference: reuse the correct Japanese title, the bold cream white type, pink/turquoise accents, solid DARK NAVY badge behind the logo with thick pale pink/cream outline. The title must strongly stand out from the light school background.
Composition: HUGE clear title in the left/center, roughly 55% of canvas, two balanced lines 「男子校の」 and 「くらげ先生」. Include a clearly readable smaller badge with exact text 「漫画」 immediately above the title. Keep the entire logo inside the image with safe margins; no characters cover any glyphs. Kurage is upper-right, medium portrait holding a clipboard, composed friendly smile. Kenji is lower-right, smaller energetic portrait with bashful cheerful expression and schoolbag. Kiritan is lower-left, visibly presenting the title. All three faces unmistakable and separated. Maintain appropriate teacher-student distance, no touch or reciprocal romance.
Backdrop: softly lit mint-and-cream Japanese high-school infirmary, subtle window light and curtain; lower contrast than faces and logo. A few restrained jellyfish motifs echo the title. Clean crisp anime ink outlines and smooth cel shading, visually consistent with images 1 and 2. Focus on a highly readable shareable final thumbnail, no extra taglines, no subtitles, no watermarks, no other words or numbers. Exact visible text only: 「漫画」 and 「男子校のくらげ先生」.
